content:
PagerDutyBot: ALERT: Multiple webhook delivery failures detected for integration 'redwood-alerts' — 18 failed deliveries in last 5m. Investigating.
Alice: seeing ~40s median ack latency on high-priority incidents, a few pages never arrived. anyone else?
Bob: yep our on-call reported two missed pages (pager -> sms) during the 10:32-10:38 window.
Carol: I'm seeing PD webhook queueing errors in logs: 503 / rate_limit_backoff from pd-webhooks endpoint. Could be PD's delivery/service degradation.
Alice: customer-facing impact?
Dave: support got escalations from two customers saying they didn't get alerts. both are on Dedicated.
Emma: putting this as P2 for now but could be P1 if it persists. I'll take lead.
Carol: runbook step 1: verify PD status page — https://status.pagerduty.com shows partial delivery issues in EU region.
Carol: runbook step 2: check our pd webhook retry queue:
```
kubectl logs -n infra pd-webhook-worker | grep rate_limit_backoff | tail -n 50
```
Carol: we have ~120 pending retries, backoff windows are long.
InfraOps: I'm going to spin up an emergency secondary integration (pd-backup) and route critical alerts there. Patch incoming to infra config.
Alice: good. can we reduce noisy low-priority alerts before failover? we don't want to flood backup.
Emma: on it. silencing non-actionable alerts for 30m now: `alerts silence --match=monitor:synthetic,severity:low --duration=30m`
Bob: started manual handoff to Emma at 10:48 — Emma is oncall-deep.
Emma: confirming — doing the PD integration swap for high/critical routes now. command: `helm upgrade --set pagerduty.integration=pd-backup infra-alerting`
Frank: heads-up — customers on EU region might still see delayed pages for a bit; we've notified CS to reach out if they escalate.
PagerDutyBot: INCIDENT UPDATE: PagerDuty reports throttling on webhook delivery; mitigation advice: use alternate integrations or SMS. More updates as available.
Carol: after switchover we saw a drop in pending retries from 120 -> 8 in 6m. ack latency down to ~6s for critical.
Bob: still seeing a handful of missed SMS for low-priority on old integration — those are expected while retries drain.
Alice: good. please post exact time of the switchover for postmortem.
Emma: switchover completed at 10:54 UTC (confirmed by alerting logs).
InfraOps: opened PD support ticket (PD-12345) and requested postmortem + root cause.
Dave: customer comms drafted and sent to affected accounts (IDs appended).
Frank: we should trigger an internal incident review — put on calendar for tomorrow 11:00.
Carol: temporary measures: 1) keep silences for noisy checks for 1h, 2) keep pd-backup routing for critical for 2h, 3) monitor retry queue.
Alice: after action: assign follow-ups: - infra to automate fallback if webhook error rate > 5% - eng-runtime to add alert that triggers before PD saturated - ops to add SMS fallback healthcheck.
Emma: adding todos now in the incident doc.
PagerDutyBot: RESOLVED: PagerDuty reports issue mitigated in affected regions. Delivery rates returning to normal.
Alice: closing notes: impact: delayed/missed pages for small subset of EU customers during 10:32-10:54 UTC. mitigations: pd-backup failover, temporary silences. next steps: automate failover and add pre-failover alerts.
Bob: thanks team — great quick work. :thumbsup:
Dave: I'll update customers later today with summary and mitigation steps.
Carol: logging incident as PD-2026-03-webhook-throttle in postmortems.
Emma: handing back on-call to Bob at 11:20 UTC.
Bob: back oncall acked.
Frank: adding link to PD support ticket and our logs to the postmortem doc.
Alice: good job everyone. keep watches for 2 hours and then we can clear silences if stable. :white_check_mark:
